text:
incident-bot: [COMMS TABLETOP DRILL] Start of communications-focused exercise. Scenario: simulated latency & 5xx increase for inference write endpoints in ap-southeast-1. THIS IS A DRILL 1 DO NOT PAGE CUSTOMER ONCALLS. Purpose: exercise approval gates, multi-stakeholder sign-off, and customer notification templates. Reply 'here' to confirm youre in. Runbook: /runbooks/comm-drills

kevin: here. I'll act as on-call incident lead. Focus: build clear timeline + technical summary for comms team.

yasmin: here. I'll act as communications approver. I'll check tone and legal flags.

olga: here. I'll simulate enterprise customer PM asking for immediate SLA credit and CC request.

mike: here. I'll operate support and route inbound customer messages.

sara: here. I'll be logging timestamps and finalizing the post-drill report.

prod-comms-bot: Reminder: for drills use prefix [DRILL-COMM] and mark subject lines with "DRILL". Also run a quick sanity check: include status page link in first external post.

kevin: quick technical stub for comms: detected 15:07 UTC increased p95 latency and 5xx ratio to ~18% for /v1/generate (ap-southeast-1). Hypothesis: backend GPU node eviction causing retry storms through the routing layer. Simulated mitigation: pause new sessions to affected pool and route traffic to healthy pool.

yasmin: drafting short public status (for header):

```
[DRILL-COMM] Intermittent errors for Redwood API in ap-southeast-1  engineers are investigating. This is an exercise; no customer data or traffic is affected.
```

kevin: drafting internal summary for #eng:

"[DRILL-COMM] Simulated elevated errors in ap-southeast-1. On-call exercised pool failover and session gating. No customer impact. Planning to publish a DRILL notice to status page for training purposes."

prod-comms-bot: NOTE: For this exercise we are practicing escalation flow including an exec notification. Communications approver must explicitly approve any exec note.

olga: role-play incoming customer message (enterprise): "We're seeing errors since 15:05 UTC. Please confirm SLA credit and CC our security lead." What should support respond?

mike: support canned reply (drill-safe): "Thanks for reaching out. This message thread is part of a scheduled communications exercise affecting ap-southeast-1 only. There is no impact to your production traffic or data. For SLA questions, please open a support ticket referencing your org ID and we'll follow up." Will CC support@redwood.com.

yasmin: legal check in-channel: do not commit to SLA credit or mention internal mitigation specifics. Use neutral language and point to support for account-level follow-up.

kevin: simulating the status page post (staging):

```
Title: [DRILL-COMM] Intermittent errors in ap-southeast-1 (exercise)
Description: 15:07 UTC  Engineers observed increased error rates for generation endpoints in ap-southeast-1. Mitigation actions simulated: session gating and pool failover. This is a planned drill; no customer traffic or data was affected.
```

prod-comms-bot: Checkpoint: communications approver (yasmin) please approve the status page short + exec note. Also confirm whether to send the customer email template to enterprise customers.

yasmin: approved for status page (DRILL wording included). Approve customer email template with two edits: 1) include link to status history, 2) add sentence: "If you have concerns, please contact your account team."

kevin: drafting exec note (private):

```
[CONFIDENTIAL - DRILL] We ran a communications drill for ap-southeast-1 at 15:07 UTC. Simulated scenario: elevated 5xx and latency. Actions exercised: pool failover, session gating, status page update, support canned responses. No impact to customer traffic/data. Recommend follow-ups: add comms approver to runbook, pre-approve enterprise CC list, measure time-to-first-public-note.
```

legal-bot: Reminder: exec note contains internal details. Mark as internal only and do not forward to customers.

olga: simulated ask: can we get SLA contact to confirm expected follow-up timeline? In production we would want a named rep. Add action: include account rep CC in customer mail for enterprise orgs.

mike: support thread created: #support-exercise-1782109876. Canned responses uploaded to KB under drills/1782109876.

sara: timings: detection (15:07) -> internal ack (15:08) -> status page draft ready (15:12) -> communications approver sign-off (15:14) -> staged status page published (15:15). Record metric: time-to-first-public-note = 8m. Target for table-top: <=10m.

kevin: quick simulated command snippets for engineering runbook (for documentation):

```bash
# simulate gating new sessions
kubectl -n infra set env deploy/routing GATE_NEW_SESSIONS=true
# route traffic to backup pool (simulation)
kubectl -n infra label nodepool/primary simulate=drain
kubectl -n infra label nodepool/backup simulate=active
```

yasmin: small copy tweak for public status: replace "session gating" with "temporarily limiting new sessions to affected pool" for clarity.

kevin: applied copy tweak. Updated status snippet ready for staging.

prod-comms-bot: Checklist validation: status page updated (staging), support KB updated, exec note drafted & marked internal, canned support replies stored. Any outstanding approvals?

yasmin: outstanding: need one named comms approver in runbook (action). Also need pre-approved enterprise CC list and a short approved line for SLA inquiries.

sara: collecting feedback for retro. Quick round: what went well / what was painful / one immediate improvement?

kevin: went well: fast internal ack and clear triage hypothesis. painful: switching between multiple channels to copy text. improvement: single UI snippet store for comms.

yasmin: went well: concise draft circulated quickly. painful: last-minute edits from legal caused minor delay. improvement: maintain evergreen legal-approved boilerplate for drills.

mike: went well: support KB update was straightforward. painful: need faster access to account rep list for enterprise orgs. improvement: add account rep lookup to support dashboard.

olga: went well: we had a clear script for enterprise replies. painful: support asked for SLA commitments which we can't provide in comms. improvement: pre-defined escalation path for SLA inquiries.

prod-comms-bot: Actions captured: 1) add comms approver role to runbook + designation steps, 2) create canonical comms snippet store (status/email/support) in incident console, 3) pre-authorize legal-safe boilerplate for drills, 4) add account-rep CC lookup to support KB, 5) include time-to-first-public-note metric in future drills. Assign owners during retro.

sara: I'll file the post-drill notes and attach timestamps + approved drafts to /docs/incidents/drills/1782109876-summary.md (simulation). Also scheduling a brief retro in 72h.

kevin: thanks everyone. Good rehearsal. Closing communications tabletop thread.

incident-bot: Drill completed: tag "drill-comm" applied. Please ensure post-drill notes uploaded and action items tracked.
